title: Psalm 102 · second version
opening_line: LORD, hear my pray’r, and let my cry

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: LORD, hear my pray’r, and let my cry
text.normalized: LORD, hear my pray’r, and let my cry

text.diplomatic: Have speedy access unto thee;
text.normalized: Have speedy access unto thee;
text.reading: Have speedy access unto thee;

text.diplomatic: In day of my calamity
text.normalized: In day of my calamity
text.reading: In day of my calamity

text.diplomatic: O hide not thou thy face from me.
text.normalized: O hide not thou thy face from me.
text.reading: O hide not thou thy face from me.

text.diplomatic: Hear when I call to thee; that day
text.normalized: Hear when I call to thee; that day
text.reading: Hear when I call to thee; that day

text.diplomatic: An answer speedily return:
text.normalized: An answer speedily return:
text.reading: An answer speedily return:

text.diplomatic: My days, like smoke, consume away,
text.normalized: My days, like smoke, consume away,
text.reading: My days, like smoke, consume away,

text.diplomatic: And, as an hearth, my bones do burn.
text.normalized: And, as an hearth, my bones do burn.
text.reading: And, as an hearth, my bones do burn.

text.diplomatic: My heart is wounded very sore,
text.normalized: My heart is wounded very sore,
text.reading: My heart is wounded very sore,

text.diplomatic: And witherèd, like grass doth fade:
text.normalized: And witherèd, like grass doth fade:
text.reading: And witherèd, like grass doth fade:

text.diplomatic: I am forgetful grown therefore
text.normalized: I am forgetful grown therefore
text.reading: I am forgetful grown therefore

text.diplomatic: To take and eat my daily bread.
text.normalized: To take and eat my daily bread.
text.reading: To take and eat my daily bread.

text.diplomatic: By reason of my smart within,
text.normalized: By reason of my smart within,
text.reading: By reason of my smart within,

text.diplomatic: And voice of my most grievous groans,
text.normalized: And voice of my most grievous groans,
text.reading: And voice of my most grievous groans,

text.diplomatic: My flesh consumèd is, my skin,
text.normalized: My flesh consumèd is, my skin,
text.reading: My flesh consumèd is, my skin,

text.diplomatic: All parched, doth cleave unto my bones.
text.normalized: All parched, doth cleave unto my bones.
text.reading: All parched, doth cleave unto my bones.

text.diplomatic: The pelican of wilderness,
text.normalized: The pelican of wilderness,
text.reading: The pelican of wilderness,

text.diplomatic: The owl in desert, I do match;
text.normalized: The owl in desert, I do match;
text.reading: The owl in desert, I do match;

text.diplomatic: And, sparrow-like, companionless,
text.normalized: And, sparrow-like, companionless,
text.reading: And, sparrow-like, companionless,

text.diplomatic: Upon the house’s top, I watch.
text.normalized: Upon the house’s top, I watch.
text.reading: Upon the house’s top, I watch.

text.diplomatic: I all day long am made a scorn,
text.normalized: I all day long am made a scorn,
text.reading: I all day long am made a scorn,

text.diplomatic: Reproached by my malicious foes:
text.normalized: Reproached by my malicious foes:
text.reading: Reproached by my malicious foes:

text.diplomatic: The madmen are against me sworn,
text.normalized: The madmen are against me sworn,
text.reading: The madmen are against me sworn,

text.diplomatic: The men against me that arose.
text.normalized: The men against me that arose.
text.reading: The men against me that arose.

text.diplomatic: For I have ashes eaten up,
text.normalized: For I have ashes eaten up,
text.reading: For I have ashes eaten up,

text.diplomatic: To me as if they had been bread;
text.normalized: To me as if they had been bread;
text.reading: To me as if they had been bread;

text.diplomatic: And with my drink I in my cup
text.normalized: And with my drink I in my cup
text.reading: And with my drink I in my cup

text.diplomatic: Of bitter tears a mixture made.
text.normalized: Of bitter tears a mixture made.
text.reading: Of bitter tears a mixture made.

text.diplomatic: Because thy wrath was not appeased,
text.normalized: Because thy wrath was not appeased,
text.reading: Because thy wrath was not appeased,

text.diplomatic: And dreadful indignätion:
text.normalized: And dreadful indignätion:
text.reading: And dreadful indignätion:

text.diplomatic: Therefore it was that thou me raised,
text.normalized: Therefore it was that thou me raised,
text.reading: Therefore it was that thou me raised,

text.diplomatic: And thou again didst cast me down.
text.normalized: And thou again didst cast me down.
text.reading: And thou again didst cast me down.

text.diplomatic: My days are like a shade alway,
text.normalized: My days are like a shade alway,
text.reading: My days are like a shade alway,

text.diplomatic: Which doth declining swiftly pass;
text.normalized: Which doth declining swiftly pass;
text.reading: Which doth declining swiftly pass;

text.diplomatic: And I am witherèd away,
text.normalized: And I am witherèd away,
text.reading: And I am witherèd away,

text.diplomatic: Much like unto the fading grass.
text.normalized: Much like unto the fading grass.
text.reading: Much like unto the fading grass.

text.diplomatic: But thou, O LORD, shalt still endure,
text.normalized: But thou, O LORD, shalt still endure,
text.reading: But thou, O LORD, shalt still endure,

text.diplomatic: From change and all mutation free,
text.normalized: From change and all mutation free,
text.reading: From change and all mutation free,

text.diplomatic: And to all generations sure
text.normalized: And to all generations sure
text.reading: And to all generations sure

text.diplomatic: Shall thy remembrance ever be.
text.normalized: Shall thy remembrance ever be.
text.reading: Shall thy remembrance ever be.

text.diplomatic: Thou shalt arise, and mercy yet
text.normalized: Thou shalt arise, and mercy yet
text.reading: Thou shalt arise, and mercy yet

text.diplomatic: Thou to mount Zion shalt extend:
text.normalized: Thou to mount Zion shalt extend:
text.reading: Thou to mount Zion shalt extend:

text.diplomatic: Her time for favour which was set,
text.normalized: Her time for favour which was set,
text.reading: Her time for favour which was set,

text.diplomatic: Behold, is now come to an end.
text.normalized: Behold, is now come to an end.
text.reading: Behold, is now come to an end.

text.diplomatic: Thy saints take pleasure in her stones,
text.normalized: Thy saints take pleasure in her stones,
text.reading: Thy saints take pleasure in her stones,

text.diplomatic: Her very dust to them is dear.
text.normalized: Her very dust to them is dear.
text.reading: Her very dust to them is dear.

text.diplomatic: All heathen lands and kingly thrones
text.normalized: All heathen lands and kingly thrones
text.reading: All heathen lands and kingly thrones

text.diplomatic: On earth thy glorious name shall fear.
text.normalized: On earth thy glorious name shall fear.
text.reading: On earth thy glorious name shall fear.

text.diplomatic: GOD in his glory shall appear,
text.normalized: GOD in his glory shall appear,
text.reading: GOD in his glory shall appear,

text.diplomatic: When Zion he builds and repairs.
text.normalized: When Zion he builds and repairs.
text.reading: When Zion he builds and repairs.

text.diplomatic: He shall regard and lend his ear
text.normalized: He shall regard and lend his ear
text.reading: He shall regard and lend his ear

text.diplomatic: Unto the needy’s humble pray’rs:
text.normalized: Unto the needy’s humble pray’rs:
text.reading: Unto the needy’s humble pray’rs:

text.diplomatic: Th’ afflicted’s pray’r he will not scorn.
text.normalized: Th’ afflicted’s pray’r he will not scorn.
text.reading: Th’ afflicted’s pray’r he will not scorn.

text.diplomatic: All times this shall be on record:
text.normalized: All times this shall be on record:
text.reading: All times this shall be on record:

text.diplomatic: And generations yet unborn
text.normalized: And generations yet unborn
text.reading: And generations yet unborn

text.diplomatic: Shall praise and magnify the LORD.
text.normalized: Shall praise and magnify the LORD.
text.reading: Shall praise and magnify the LORD.

text.diplomatic: He from his holy place looked down,
text.normalized: He from his holy place looked down,
text.reading: He from his holy place looked down,

text.diplomatic: The earth he viewed from heav’n on high;
text.normalized: The earth he viewed from heav’n on high;
text.reading: The earth he viewed from heav’n on high;

text.diplomatic: To hear the pris’ner’s mourning groan,
text.normalized: To hear the pris’ner’s mourning groan,
text.reading: To hear the pris’ner’s mourning groan,

text.diplomatic: And free them that are doomed to die;
text.normalized: And free them that are doomed to die;
text.reading: And free them that are doomed to die;

text.diplomatic: That Zion, and Jerus’lem too,
text.normalized: That Zion, and Jerus’lem too,
text.reading: That Zion, and Jerus’lem too,

text.diplomatic: His name and praise may well record,
text.normalized: His name and praise may well record,
text.reading: His name and praise may well record,

text.diplomatic: When people and the kingdoms do
text.normalized: When people and the kingdoms do
text.reading: When people and the kingdoms do

text.diplomatic: Assemble all to praise the LORD.
text.normalized: Assemble all to praise the LORD.
text.reading: Assemble all to praise the LORD.

text.diplomatic: My strength he weakened in the way,
text.normalized: My strength he weakened in the way,
text.reading: My strength he weakened in the way,

text.diplomatic: My days of life he shortenèd.
text.normalized: My days of life he shortenèd.
text.reading: My days of life he shortenèd.

text.diplomatic: My God, O take me not away
text.normalized: My God, O take me not away
text.reading: My God, O take me not away

text.diplomatic: In mid-time of my days, I said:
text.normalized: In mid-time of my days, I said:
text.reading: In mid-time of my days, I said:

text.diplomatic: Thy years throughout all ages last.
text.normalized: Thy years throughout all ages last.
text.reading: Thy years throughout all ages last.

text.diplomatic: Of old thou hast establishèd
text.normalized: Of old thou hast establishèd
text.reading: Of old thou hast establishèd

text.diplomatic: The earth’s foundation firm and fast:
text.normalized: The earth’s foundation firm and fast:
text.reading: The earth’s foundation firm and fast:

text.diplomatic: Thy mighty hands the heav’ns have made.
text.normalized: Thy mighty hands the heav’ns have made.
text.reading: Thy mighty hands the heav’ns have made.

text.diplomatic: They perish shall, as garments do,
text.normalized: They perish shall, as garments do,
text.reading: They perish shall, as garments do,

text.diplomatic: But thou shalt evermore endure;
text.normalized: But thou shalt evermore endure;
text.reading: But thou shalt evermore endure;

text.diplomatic: As vestures, thou shalt change them so;
text.normalized: As vestures, thou shalt change them so;
text.reading: As vestures, thou shalt change them so;

text.diplomatic: And they shall all be changèd sure:
text.normalized: And they shall all be changèd sure:
text.reading: And they shall all be changèd sure:

text.diplomatic: But from all changes thou art free;
text.normalized: But from all changes thou art free;
text.reading: But from all changes thou art free;

text.diplomatic: Thy endless years do last for aye.
text.normalized: Thy endless years do last for aye.
text.reading: Thy endless years do last for aye.

text.diplomatic: Thy servants, and their seed who be,
text.normalized: Thy servants, and their seed who be,
text.reading: Thy servants, and their seed who be,

text.diplomatic: Established shall before thee stay.
